name: vn-preparation-table-v1

input.name: vn-preparation-table-v1
input.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one isolated map prop. Subject: One low preparation workbench, straight warm-ivory stone top on sturdy petrol-teal stained wooden legs, small bronze corner joints. On the table only: one squat ink pot, one shallow jade mortar, a folded ivory cloth and two trimmed medicinal sprigs; they are a single table-top set with one before/after relation. No stool, floor patch, backdrop, loose objects outside the table or human. Show the full feet and front-right support.
Style: VAN NGOC gameplay illustration: decisive dark petrol outline, clean three-tone cel shading, broad readable material planes. Celadon jade, petrol teal shadows, warm ivory highlights and restrained antique bronze. Warm upper-left light. Crisp hand-painted fantasy game asset, consistent with the approved bright jade-and-cloud monastery map. No photographic rendering, soft airbrush, tiny noisy filigree, bloom, labels, runes, typography, watermark or UI frame. These are art references described in text; no reference pixels are transmitted by this tool.
Camera: orthographic high-angle RPG view, approximately 40 degrees downward. Front and top faces visible, parallel vertical supports, no vanishing point, no dramatic low-angle perspective. Lighting upper left. A human uses 64x96 native frame with feet at (32,88); final prop body target 160x115 pixels inside 192x160 canvas, source is larger for clean native export. Center the complete silhouette with 12 percent empty magenta margin; base must be fully visible. Flat #FF00FF background; no ground shadow, floor or scenery.
